title: CIA-UAP-016, Sightings of Unidentified Flying Objects in Ladakh, Nepal, Sikkim and Bhutan
doc_notes: This is a CIA intelligence report summarizing various aerial sightings and one physical trace report in the Himalayan region; only the physical trace report meets the criteria for an encounter.

encounters.summary: A metallic disc-shaped object with a saw-tooth base and two feet in height was found in a crater at Baltichaur, with additional portions found at Okhaldhunga.
encounters.entity_appearance: metallic disc-shaped object with a saw-tooth base
